headline: Turn cart friction into consent-aware recovery planning without touching a shopper or cart.
capabilities: Segment abandoned carts by value and recovery likelihood
Generate personalized offers and urgency messaging for each segment
Deploy multi-touch campaigns across email, SMS, and retargeting with optimized timing
Forecast recovery rates and revenue impact for leadership reporting
outcomes: Increased recovery rates through precision targeting and personalized incentives
Protected margins with discount guardrails and alternative offers
Reduced manual workloads and response times
Improved decision-making with real-time performance dashboards
why_try: It helps growth and digital teams pressure-test recovery ideas while preserving consent, margin governance, and activation controls.
